Meaning: Two continuously synthesized aligned periods. The first is startup; the second is the candidate loop. Its start/end complete normalized synthesizer states must match, so deterministic future synthesis recurs from that boundary. The independent opening PCM, sources and runtime are still pinned. No later loop period is synthesized independently. Restricted to this pinned dry single-group model/assets/runtime, not other synthesizers or full SF2 fidelity. No playback device or host integration.
